prompt:
Draw ONE complete full-colour manga PAGE, portrait, read left to right, with exactly FOUR panels, black panel borders, thin white gutters and a small white page margin. Style: approachable Indian slice-of-life manga, clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural light, simple readable backgrounds, expressive natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. BALLOON SPACE: in EVERY panel keep the upper quarter as plain empty background (plain wall, ceiling or sky) with no faces, hands, screens or important objects in it; speech balloons and captions are added there later. Keep heads below that band. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, words, numbers, speech balloons, captions, sound effects, signage text, logos, brand marks or watermarks. Do not draw any Welbuk logo, and no heart, cross or medical-cross symbols anywhere: buildings, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and icons never show a cross or plus sign. Screens show only simple abstract interface shapes: a hot-pink (#FD006A) header bar, white cards, grey lines, simple icons and charts; never readable text or numbers. All data is fictional.

REFERENCE IMAGES: .

CAST ON THIS PAGE:

PAGE LAYOUT: Panel 1 tall on the left half spanning the top 62% of the page; panels 2 and 3 stacked on the right half beside it; panel 4 full-width at the bottom (about 38%).

PAGE NOTES: Infrastructure concepts drawn as simple, clearly separate diagrams.
